messages:
maria-sales: BigBank POC signed off on traffic profile. Steady ~180 RPS with frequent micro-bursts to ~650 RPS lasting ~2060s every few hours. They want a clear reserve+burst proposal + answers for the security checklist today.
ethan-solutions: Need to know request shape: chat turns vs single long prompts. That changes batching and KV cache effectiveness.
rachel-sre: They provided split: 80% chat-like (300 tokens), 20% long completions (up to 1500 tokens). High tail matters.
dave-runtime: Rough mapping: steady 180 RPS * 45 toks ~= 8.1k toks/s. Peak 650 RPS ~= 29.25k toks/s. For our M-class models that implies ~4 reserved GPUs for steady baseline + 4600% more for headroom. Quantized variants reduce GPU need ~35%.
sana-security: Security heads-up: BigBank requires VPC-only control plane, KMS CMEK, SOC2 + ISO attestation notes, and explicit data-deletion SLA. I'll fill questionnaire items but need the exact data flow and retention window.
maria-sales: Pricing ask: give two options (conservative vs cost-optimized) with monthly numbers including burst credit estimate. Also include ops buffer.
dave-runtime: Draft autoscale + burst approach:
```
min_replicas: 4            # reserved baseline
rps_per_replica: 50
max_replicas: 16           # allows headroom for spikes
burst_pool: 4              # hot burst GPUs (separate billing as credits)
quantized_fallback: true   # 4-bit during sustained burst
canary_fallback: smaller-model if p99 > 1.2s
cooldown: 45s
```
This maps to reserve 4 GPUs, hot-burst 4 GPUs, autoscale to 16 replicas (replica can map to fractional GPU depending on instance).
deploy-bot: Cost sim finished: conservative = $78,600/mo (4 reserved GPUs + 4 hot-burst credits incl ops margin). cost-optimized = $48,900/mo (2 reserved GPUs + larger burst + quantized fallback). Link: https://ops.redwood.example/sim/1763033333
rachel-sre: Ops notes: prewarm KV prefixes for known user flows 300s before predicted spikes. Add a warmup lambda to proactively populate cache. Add circuit-breaker to route to smaller model under extreme pressure.
ethan-solutions: I'll assemble proposal language: Option A (Conservative): 4x reserved + 4x burst (fastest p99, higher cost). Option B (Optimized): 2x reserved + 6x burst + quantized fallback + canary (lower cost, ~20-40% higher tail risk). Include explicit SLAs and rollback plan.
sana-security: I'll attach answers for KMS, VPC control plane, data retention, and isolation by 16:30 UTC. Need statement on logs retention and customer-managed keys.
maria-sales: Great. If @dave-runtime posts the per-model perf numbers and p99 estimates by 15:30 I can push the proposal. We're aiming to close the commit this week. Thanks team :rocket:
